rules: All instructions, including unreachable instructions, are validated before execution.
Unused fields and reserved bytes must be zero; targets are instruction indices.
Input count is at most REGISTERS. LOAD_INPUT A is an input index; other A/B are register indices.
SHL/SHR require the runtime shift register to be at most 63. JULT compares unsigned u64.
Program encoding is MethodCodec(programKey), id=0, DOMAIN; positions are absolute program byte offsets.
The trusted FNV-1a checksum covers encoded program bytes. Opcode table entries are unique bytes.
